description: Compare each station's average bandwidth usage with the mean bandwidth usage over all individual telescopes.

a.request: Average the bandwidth usage (`bandusagepct`) of the telescopes at each observatory station, ignoring missing values. Take as the baseline the average bandwidth usage over all telescopes (each telescope counting once). For the stations whose average is above that baseline, return one row with two unrounded values: the mean of those stations' averages, and the mean amount by which they exceed the baseline.
a.sql: WITH station_averages AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS station_avg FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS overall_avg FROM telescopes) SELECT AVG(sa.station_avg) AS mean_station_average, AVG(sa.station_avg - b.overall_avg) AS mean_excess FROM station_averages AS sa CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE sa.station_avg > b.overall_avg;

c.request: For observatory stations whose average telescope bandwidth usage (`bandusagepct`) is above average, what is their mean bandwidth usage, and how far above average are they on average? Ignore missing usage values, and give both figures unrounded in a single row. Compare each station's average bandwidth usage with the mean bandwidth usage over all individual telescopes.
c.sql: WITH overall AS (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_usage FROM telescopes), station_averages AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_usage FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY observstation) SELECT AVG(s.avg_usage) AS mean_bandwidth_usage, AVG(s.avg_usage - o.avg_usage) AS mean_above_average FROM station_averages AS s CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE s.avg_usage > o.avg_usage

b.request: For stations whose mean non-null telescope bandwidth usage exceeds the mean non-null bandwidth usage across all individual telescopes, return one row with the mean of those stations’ mean usages and the mean amount by which those station means exceed the telescope-wide mean, both unrounded
b.sql: WITH station_means AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS mean_usage FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), telescope_mean AS (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS mean_usage FROM telescopes) SELECT AVG(s.mean_usage) AS mean_station_usage, AVG(s.mean_usage - t.mean_usage) AS mean_excess_usage FROM station_means AS s CROSS JOIN telescope_mean AS t WHERE s.mean_usage > t.mean_usage

d.request: For each observatory station, what is its average telescope bandwidth usage (`bandusagepct`), and how far is it above or below the mean across all individual telescopes? Ignore missing usage values and leave the results unrounded.
d.sql: SELECT o.observstation, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct, AVG(t.bandusagepct) - g.overall_avg AS difference_from_overall_avg FROM observatories AS o CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS overall_avg FROM telescopes) AS g LEFT JOIN telescopes AS t ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation, g.overall_avg ORDER BY o.observstation;
